children.name: working professional residing in a metropolitan city in India. She believes in sustainable living practices and actively seeks ways to reduce her carbon footprint. She is concerned about the environmental impact of fast fashion and wants to make more conscious choices when it comes to her clothing purchases.

children.name: She feels a sense of responsibility towards the environment and wants to contribute to its preservation. She feels frustrated by the excessive waste and resource consumption associated with the fashion industry. She wants to make a positive impact by supporting eco-friendly initiatives and reducing clothing waste.

children.name: actively researches and explores different avenues to find sustainable fashion options. She frequently visits thrift stores, participates in clothing swap events, and seeks out online platforms that specialize in second-hand clothing. She prefers apps and websites that offer a user-friendly interface, detailed product descriptions, and options to filter by price, size, and condition.

children.name: She often talks about the importance of sustainable fashion and the need to promote circular economy practices. She expresses her desire to find affordable and high-quality second-hand clothing options that align with her values. She seeks recommendations for reliable platforms that offer a wide range of pre-loved clothes at reasonable prices.
